text: Welcome back to the weekly builders space. Today we are talking about AI tools for small teams.
Our first guest runs a two person design studio and uses speech to text every single day.
The biggest win for us was turning long client calls into searchable transcripts.
Before that we lost a lot of decisions because nobody remembered who said what.
Speaker labels matter more than people think, because a transcript without names is hard to trust.
Let's move on to cost. Running Whisper locally on a laptop is now fast enough for most meetings.
On an Apple silicon Mac the small model handles an hour of audio in a few minutes.
Cloud APIs are still easier to set up, but local models keep client audio private.
Privacy was the deciding factor for our clients in healthcare and legal work.
Last topic: what would you automate next if you had one more weekend?
I would split long recordings by topic so each chapter gets its own short summary.
That is exactly the kind of pipeline we will try to build together next week. Thanks everyone.
